result.brief: 该工作构建真实到仿真的机器人场景重建（度量尺度几何、物理参数、高斯泼溅场景），验证更高保真重建能缩小仿真与真实评测差距，为具身世界模型的环境建模提供证据。
result.reason: Real-to-sim reconstruction with Gaussian-splat scenes and physics improves sim-to-real fidelity for robot evaluation; relates to embodied world modeling but lacks video prediction or action-conditioned dynamics.
